title_lines: 城堡产品接盘后迅速转手
市场波动中如何锁定收益

subtitles.en: What we knew was, let's just say, Ash and Brenner, Leopold, Ash and Brenner got a little trouble, situational awareness, gotten to a little trouble, Ken Griffin came riding in to the rescue
subtitles.zh: 我们当时知道的是，Ash和Brenner，Leopold，Ash和Brenner遇到了一些麻烦，情况感知出了问题，Ken Griffin像过去一样骑马赶来救援

subtitles.en: as he's done in the past, bought up some assets, we don't know so exactly what, presumably at a discount.
subtitles.zh: 他买了一些资产，我们不清楚具体是什么，大概有折扣。

subtitles.en: Now he's out with the letter, saying he all floated 80% of the risk.
subtitles.zh: 现在他发了一封信，说他已转移了80%的风险。

subtitles.en: So what does that tell me? Yeah, he doesn't make a bunch of money.
subtitles.zh: 这告诉我什么？是的，他没有赚很多钱。
en_highlights: doesn't make a bunch of money

subtitles.en: Yes, basically, he did buy this at a 10% discount.
subtitles.zh: 是的，基本上，他确实以10%的折扣买入了这些资产。

subtitles.en: Also, these were assets that are already fallen in their value. So an added discount to that too, selling a good portion of what he did by to the market.
subtitles.zh: 而且，这些资产的价值已经下跌，所以还有额外折扣，他将买入的大部分卖给了市场。

subtitles.en: Some of those were block trades, at least $4 billion worth.
subtitles.zh: 其中一些是大宗交易，至少价值40亿美元。

subtitles.en: So we do see him sort of like locking in those gains, selling them at a premium to whatever he bought them at, which is what hedge funds do,
subtitles.zh: 所以我们看到他锁定收益，以高于买入价的价格卖出，这正是对冲基金的做法。

subtitles.en: and making a sizable chunk of money off the back of this deal.
subtitles.zh: 并在这笔交易中赚取了可观的利润。

subtitles.en: Well, do we know exactly how sizable that chunk of money was?
subtitles.zh: 那么，我们确切知道这笔利润有多大吗？

subtitles.en: Are you able to talk a little bit about how it did boost Citadel's returns?
subtitles.zh: 您能谈谈这笔交易如何提升了Citadel的回报吗？

subtitles.en: Yes, so the fund was up about 6%, like 5.7% through to June for the year.
subtitles.zh: 是的，该基金今年截至6月上涨约6%，具体为5.7%。

subtitles.en: In the month of July, it made an additional 6% in gains.
subtitles.zh: 7月份，该基金又获得了6%的收益。

subtitles.en: It made more than it made all year in one month alone on the back of this deal.
subtitles.zh: 仅一个月就赚得比全年还多，全靠这笔交易。

subtitles.en: So the fund is now up 12% year to date, which is a great turn of events from going from, basically doubling their return in just one month
subtitles.zh: 因此，该基金年初至今上涨12%，这是一个巨大的转变，基本上在一个月内就使回报翻倍。

subtitles.en: on the back of what was a great deal for them, for sure.
subtitles.zh: 这无疑是一笔对他们非常有利的交易。
